title: FBO Account Structure Simulator
description: Visual simulator for FBO account structures. Model omnibus vs. subledger architectures, pooled accounts, settlement timing, reserve logic, FDIC pass-through eligibility. Outputs operational risk score and Markdown architecture memo. Client-side. Zero PII.
